## Overview

RDFLib.jl provides utility functions for analyzing, transforming, and visualizing RDF graphs. This vignette covers graph statistics, connected components, VoID metadata, event handling, and DOT export.

```{julia}
using RDFLib
ex = Namespace("http://example.org/")
```

## Graph Statistics

```{julia}
g = parse_rdf("""
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
    @prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

    ex:alice a ex:Person ;
        rdfs:label "Alice" ;
        ex:knows ex:bob, ex:carol .

    ex:bob a ex:Person ;
        rdfs:label "Bob" ;
        ex:knows ex:carol .

    ex:carol a ex:Person ;
        rdfs:label "Carol" .

    ex:project1 a ex:Project ;
        rdfs:label "RDFLib.jl" ;
        ex:contributor ex:alice, ex:bob .
""", TurtleFormat())

stats = graph_stats(g)
for k in keys(stats)
    println("  $k: $(stats[k])")
end
```

## All Nodes

```{julia}
nodes = all_nodes(g)
println("Unique nodes in graph:")
for n in nodes
    println("  ", n)
end
```

## Connected Components

Find disconnected subgraphs:

```{julia}
g2 = parse_rdf("""
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .

    # Component 1: Social network
    ex:alice ex:knows ex:bob .
    ex:bob ex:knows ex:carol .

    # Component 2: Isolated
    ex:sun ex:type "Star" .
    ex:earth ex:orbits ex:sun .
""", TurtleFormat())

components = connected_components(g2)
println("Found $(length(components)) connected components:")
for (i, comp) in enumerate(components)
    println("  Component $i: $(length(comp)) triples")
    for t in comp
        println("    ", t)
    end
end
```

## VoID (Vocabulary of Interlinked Datasets)

Generate metadata about your dataset:

```{julia}
void_graph = generate_void(g, ex("myDataset"))
println(serialize(void_graph, TurtleFormat()))
```

## Visualization with DOT

Export graphs as Graphviz DOT format for visualization:

```{julia}
small_g = parse_rdf("""
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
    ex:alice ex:knows ex:bob .
    ex:bob ex:knows ex:carol .
    ex:carol ex:knows ex:alice .
""", TurtleFormat())

dot = to_dot(small_g)
println(dot)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
# Render to SVG (requires Graphviz installed)
svg = render_dot(dot)

# Save visualization directly
save_visualization(g, "my_graph.svg")
save_visualization(g, "my_graph.png")
```

## Schema Visualization

Visualize class hierarchies and property relationships:

```{julia}
schema_g = parse_rdf("""
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
    @prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
    @prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .

    ex:Animal a owl:Class .
    ex:Mammal a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ex:Animal .
    ex:Dog a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ex:Mammal .
    ex:Cat a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ex:Mammal .

    ex:hasName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
        rdfs:domain ex:Animal .
    ex:hasOwner a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:domain ex:Animal ;
        rdfs:range ex:Person .
""", TurtleFormat())

schema_dot = rdfs2dot(schema_g)
println(schema_dot)
```

## Event System

Monitor graph changes with the event system:

```{julia}
g3 = RDFGraph()
dispatcher = EventDispatcher()
obs = ObservableGraph(g3, dispatcher)

# Register event handlers
global additions = 0
on!(dispatcher, TripleAdded, event -> (global additions += 1))

# Changes trigger events
add!(obs, Triple(ex("a"), ex("p"), Literal("1")))
add!(obs, Triple(ex("b"), ex("q"), Literal("2")))
add!(obs, Triple(ex("c"), ex("r"), Literal("3")))

println("Additions tracked: $additions")
```

## Plugin System

Register custom parsers and serializers:

```{julia}
# List available parsers and serializers
println("Registered parsers:")
for p in list_parsers()
    println("  ", p)
end

println("\nRegistered serializers:")
for s in list_serializers()
    println("  ", s)
end
```

```{julia}
# Register a custom serializer
my_serializer = function(graph)
    buf = IOBuffer()
    for t in graph
        write(buf, "FACT: $(n3(t.subject)) --[$(n3(t.predicate))]--> $(n3(t.object))\n")
    end
    String(take!(buf))
end
register_serializer!("text/x-myformat", my_serializer)

# Use it
g4 = parse_rdf("""
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
    ex:a ex:likes ex:b .
    ex:b ex:likes ex:c .
""", TurtleFormat())

custom = get_serializer("text/x-myformat")
println(custom(g4))

# Clean up
unregister_serializer!("text/x-myformat")
```

## Chunked Processing

Process large graphs in chunks:

```{julia}
# Create a moderately large graph
g5 = RDFGraph()
for i in 1:100
    add!(g5, Triple(ex("item$i"), RDF.type, ex("Thing")))
    add!(g5, Triple(ex("item$i"), RDFS("label"), Literal("Item $i")))
end

# Serialize in chunks to an IOBuffer
buf = IOBuffer()
serialize_chunked(g5, NTriplesFormat(), buf; chunk_size=50)
output = String(take!(buf))
lines = split(output, '\n')
println("Serialized $(length(lines)-1) triples")
println("First 200 chars preview:")
println(first(output, 200), "...")
```

## XSD Date/Time Utilities

```{julia}
using Dates

# Format Julia dates as XSD literals
d = Date(2025, 3, 15)
dt = DateTime(2025, 3, 15, 10, 30, 0)
t = Time(14, 30, 0)

println("XSD date:     ", n3(xsd_literal(d)))
println("XSD dateTime: ", n3(xsd_literal(dt)))

# Parse XSD strings
parsed_dt = parse_xsd_datetime("2025-03-15T10:30:00")
println("Parsed: ", parsed_dt)
```

## CLI Utilities

RDFLib.jl includes command-line style utilities:

```{julia}
# Convert between formats (rdfpipe)
turtle_input = """
    @prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .
    ex:a ex:p "hello" .
    ex:b ex:q "world" .
"""

nt_output = rdfpipe(turtle_input, TurtleFormat(), NTriplesFormat())
println("Converted to N-Triples:")
println(nt_output)
```

```{julia}
# CSV to RDF conversion
csv_data = """name,age,city
Alice,30,London
Bob,25,Paris
Carol,35,Tokyo
"""

csv_rdf = csv2rdf(csv_data, "http://example.org/person/")
println("CSV as RDF ($(length(csv_rdf)) triples):")
println(serialize(csv_rdf, TurtleFormat()))
```
